title: Sea Spirit Over Ships
description: A luminous female sea spirit with long flowing white hair and pointed ears floats above a stormy ocean, holding an ornate staff topped with a glowing blue orb. She wears a flowing white and gold gown that merges into swirling turquoise water, surrounded by glowing flowers, butterflies, and aurora lights while two wooden sailing ships battle rough waves below.
prompt: A beautiful female sea spirit with long flowing white hair and elf ears floats gracefully above a turbulent ocean, wearing a translucent white and gold gown that swirls into waves of water at her lower body. She holds an ornate golden staff with a glowing blue orb, surrounded by luminous white and orange flowers and butterflies. In the background, two old wooden sailing ships navigate stormy seas under a dramatic sky with aurora borealis, rain, and magical light particles.
